contexts.text: As whales = scientifics which pervert the truths of faith, they = reasonings from fallacies, whence come falsities... Like things are signified by leviathan in ; and in .
In a good sense, leviathan = reason from truths (). Reason from truths is the opposite to reasonings from falsities, AC 9755:4.
I said. You are also leviathans... the crooked leviathans... and the longish leviathans... TCR 182:end.
I said... Open that faith, and you will see... leviathan...

Leviathan the longish serpent () = those who reject all things which they do not see with their eyes; thus the merely sensuous, who are devoid of faith because they do not comprehend. Leviathan the crooked serpent () = those who on this account do not believe, and yet say that they believe.
Whales and leviathan () = scientifics, which are of the sensuous and natural man, from which is all falsity, when the spiritual man is closed above them.
By leviathan, that is, a whale, () are meant all things of the natural man in the complex; which is said to play in the sea, from the delight of knowing and thence of being wise.
Their cunning is signified by leviathan the crooked serpent.
